title: Quick Canadian Porridge Oats Hash
description: An umami and pillowy one-pot Canadian dish featuring porridge oats, perfect for a weeknight dinner or weekend brunch.
instructions: Heat the lard in a ttukbaegi or a large Dutch oven over medium-low heat.
Add the minced onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly caramelized.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the crumbled bacon and cook until crispy.
Add the porridge oats, water, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, covered, for 5 minutes.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for an additional 10-15 minutes or until the oats have absorbed most of the liquid and have a creamy consistency.
Serve hot, garnished with additional thyme if desired.
